title: LidarScan Builder: sink parameters, ref-qualified build(), RVO
hints: Chaining works when each setter returns `*this` as `ScanBuilder&`.
Sink parameter idiom: take `std::string id` **by value**, then `frame_ = std::move(id);`. Lvalue callers pay one copy and rvalue callers pay only moves.
Overload on the object's value category: `LidarScan build() const&` copies the members, `LidarScan build() &&` moves them out (`std::move(ranges_)`).
`clampRanges(std::vector<double> r, ...)`: modify `r` in place and `return r;`. A by-value parameter is implicitly moved on return, so the caller's buffer survives a `std::move` all the way through.
